rule_or_pattern: [^\s\d-]- \S  (a mid-label hyphen followed by a space and more text: Google appended the next print line's word continuation to this line's label)
notes: This is a polytonic 1926 katharevousa economics book. Breathings, accents, iota subscripts and the German terms (9 'Generalrat') read correctly in almost every line. The spacing-breathing capitals (᾿Α in 22, 27-40) are covered by the pool-wide rule. The one describable fault: lines ending in a hyphenated break get the start of the next print line appended (19 'ὀλιγο- μήνου', 39 'φιλελευ- θέρας της'), so the label holds text that is not in the crop. Minor single errors: 30 'Ολλανδὸς', 'Ίτα-' without breathing; 21 'Geld>' for 'Geld»'.
